Totals for today, 7 and 30 days, then per day, per model and per feature over 30 days. scope=all covers every user and adds a per user breakdown; it needs ai.usage.view_all. offset is the browser's time zone offset in minutes, as getTimezoneOffset gives it, so days are the viewer's own.
